paragraphs: In pod XXAMMV, Lea, Ana and Bo set out to showcase: input in time, and local minimum wage authorizing value, and closed one synchronized session against the measurable outcome they set: two clocked segments, three outcomes, three currencies on one receipt. Whether it was met is for the record and the witnesses below, not for this summary. They recorded it in written words, so the outcome is evidence a settlement can stand on, not a claim taken on trust. In their own words, the pod noted: "Three phones, two clocked segments, three currencies: this receipt is the outcome". Measurement of Time keeps the actual minutes on the record, separate from the tokens that settled.

Because the work was witnessed, 0.0138 cross-reviewed hours settled as 0.041 웃, computed as M times hours, with M of 3, and each person is bound by the 9,999-per-year ceiling with the rest rolling forward. The pod finished 1.9862 hours inside its 2.0000-hour frozen baseline, but the conditions for a bonus were not all confirmed, so no ◬ were recognised; the accelerator reads the hours delta only, never a profit metric. Nothing new was minted; the pod only gated ♡, 웃, and ◬ that already exist. Where a capability is not yet lawful in a place, it fails closed rather than falling over. Recognition is not money, and qualification is not conversion.

The outcome now feeds the backlog, where this pod, or the next, can adopt the following Task and Outcome from the same three projects and carry the thread forward. Measurement of Time keeps every actual minute on the append-only ledger, apart from the 웃 that settled, so the whole session replays exactly as it happened. Where the work grows a project's financial-innovation, the Qualified Innovation Score measures it and its growth sizes the reward pool — a measurement, never a second mint. The reward pool is sized by qualified growth after qualification, and it mints no token by itself. Human authority remains accountable for every consequential decision, and the sovereign layer stays closed to machines.
